info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Account Statement Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Account Statement Retrieval API allows users to access detailed account statements for specific customers. By providing a customer ID and an account ID, this API facilitates the retrieval of financial transaction histories, enabling users to gain insights into account activities. Typical consumers include financial institutions, customer service representatives, and accounting professionals who require accurate and timely financial reporting. This service supports various use cases such as auditing, account reconciliation, and customer inquiries.

get.summary: Retrieve account statement for a specific customer account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the account statement details for a specified customer account identified by the customer ID and account ID. Users can access transaction history and other related statement information through this endpoint.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the statement for the specified customer account. It includes necessary information to process the account statement request.

GetCustomerAccountStatementCUST100045ACC.description: This schema represents the request body for fetching the statement of a specific account belonging to a particular customer.
